<!-- pr-reviewer: d41c2b76abcfc2d66ded1d98668fe71d8d07b80e -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The code fixes findings 1 to 3 and most of finding 4. Two blockers remain: the `Changelog:` row does not state the load of the ramp, and the recorded #3588 decision keeps this PR out of the merge. The code review is clean.

## What looks good

- The ramp runs only at a dead end that the plan marks. `level_order::order` marks each later Outside pass that no lead-in reaches (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/level_order.rs:140-146`). `level_ramp_entry::dead_end_ramp` enters only one of those starts (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/level_ramp_entry.rs:100-103`). The first entry of a level and the ring 0 pieces keep the old entry.
- The plan checks each marked dead end before the ladder posts it. A dead end too short for the ramp sends the area to the Auto order (`level_rings.rs:78-88`), with a note that carries `RINGS_FALLBACK` (`pass_start.rs:130-134`) and raises `Warning::StrategyFallback`. No silent plunge.
- The pin tells a ramp from a steep feed. It uses the ramp angle plus 0.05 degrees and 0.02 mm on the pass (`crates/motion/tests/pass_start_engagement.rs:43-48`, `112-116`), and it asserts that a ramp ran (`:186-191`).
- A Plunge, Helix or Arc entry that the ramp replaces is named once, in the #2265 stand-in form (`level_ramp_entry.rs:80-90`, `123-125`).
- `levels.rs` has 456 lines here and 459 on main. The new code is in `level_ramp_entry.rs` (265 lines). No process file, no new dependency, no golden and no snapshot PNG change.

## The findings of the review at e7ae538a3

1. **No silent plunge: fixed.** `too_short_at` (`level_ramp_entry.rs:70-75`) checks each marked dead end at the deepest descent of any cut level. `ring_plan_ramped` sends the area to the Auto order, named (`level_rings.rs:78-88`). The note is a rings fallback (`level_ramp_entry.rs:226-231`). The pin `a_dead_end_too_short_for_the_ramp_falls_back_to_pure_auto` (`pass_start_engagement.rs:298`) asserts one `RINGS_FALLBACK` note and that the moves equal the Auto run byte for byte. The ladder has a second named note for its backstop (`level_ramp_entry.rs:117-120`).
2. **Slope law: fixed.** `is_ramp` requires at most 3.05 degrees and every swept centre within 0.02 mm of a floor feed (`pass_start_engagement.rs:112-116`). `a_steep_straight_feed_is_not_a_ramp` (`:194`) proves that a 60-degree feed and a vertical feed are not ramps. The late-entry pin asserts that a ramp ran (`:186-191`). The 332.88 mm2 red reading on main is the author's and the earlier reviewer's; I did not rebuild main. The new measure counts every non-ramp entry, so it is stricter than the old measure.
3. **Named stand-in: fixed.** `stand_in_note` names Plunge, Helix and Arc, and returns `None` for a Ramp entry (`level_ramp_entry.rs:80-90`). `PathBuilder::note_once` keeps it to one note for the operation (`crates/cl/src/cl/path.rs:240-244`). The unit pin is `a_replaced_entry_is_named` (`level_ramp_entry.rs:235-250`).
4. **Plain words: part fixed.** The decision file (`docs/decisions/3567-ramp-entry-at-dead-end.md:36`) and the PR body (item 5) say that the ramp cuts a slot at nearly the full tool width at the ramp angle, and they name 2D Offset and 2D Pocket with Outside. They also correct the earlier 83 percent figure: the pin prints 25 percent of the disc (12.6 of 50.3 mm2) at each of the 8 starts, and a band of 4.780 mm. The `Changelog:` row still does not state the load. See requested change 1.
5. **`levels.rs`: fixed.** 456 lines here, 459 on main.
6. **The file collision with #3566: this PR owns the file.** #3566 still lists the same file. It must drop its copy before either PR merges.

## Results merged with main

Trial merge with `origin/main` (60376ccbb) clean. Built and tested locally in `.claude/worktrees/pr-3577-rev2`: `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3`, `-j 3`. I did not start `pr-test.yml`.

| step | result | time |
|---|---|---|
| motion `pass_start_engagement` | 6 passed | 1.25 s |
| motion `pass_start_levels` | 7 passed | 10.66 s |
| motion lib `machining2d` | 267 passed, 10 ignored | 80.4 s |
| motion lib `level_ramp_entry` | 4 passed | 0.1 s |
| app `offset_pass_start` | 4 passed, 2 ignored (heavy lane) | 42.4 s |
| app `pocket_pass_start` | 5 of 6 passed; the slow test did not finish (see below) | 29 min 23 s |
| app `golden_cl` | 33 passed | 2.3 s |
| app `conformance` | 7 passed | 6.8 s |
| app `adaptive_pass_start` | 4 passed | 36.0 s |
| app `bore_pass_start` | 3 passed | 0.1 s |
| app `example_catalog` | 37 passed, 4 ignored | 10.8 s |
| app `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed | 0.05 s |
| app `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed | 0.01 s |
| clippy `-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean | 1 min 48 s |

`pocket_pass_start`: the other 5 tests pass in 38.4 s in a separate run. `fig8_pocket_outside_starts_each_level_at_the_stock_edge` was still in the verifier after 29 min 23 s. I stopped it with SIGTERM, so it has no functional verdict. The author's 961 s figure is low. A parallel run of the same test in another worktree was still running after 50 minutes.

The quick plan selects 152 suites for this diff. I ran the suites that the review brief names.

## Targeted tests

- Example catalog: the three suites above. No posted `.nc` changed.
- Light lane: `cargo xtask gate light` green. The light build took 285 s; `motion light: lib` passed in 10 s; `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` passed in 8 s. 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- Heavy: none. The issue is `P2` (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review"). The two ignored `offset_pass_start` fig8 Outside tests are heavy-lane tests (about 170 s each); I did not run them.

## Requested before merge

1. **State the load of the ramp in the `Changelog:` row.** The recorded decision (issue #3567, 23:24Z, quoted at `docs/decisions/3567-ramp-entry-at-dead-end.md:23`) says to state the full-width ramp in the changelog. The row names 2D Offset and 2D Pocket and the angle, but it does not say that the ramp cuts a slot at nearly the full tool width at the ramp angle where the ring before does not reach the dead end. Add one sentence. The decision file and the PR body already say it.
2. **Keep the #3588 block.** The recorded decision on #3567 and the PR body say this PR does not merge before #3588 is fixed and `pocket_pass_start` runs in a normal time. #3588 is open; its fix is PR #3595 (draft). The full suite did not finish in 29 min 23 s, and the quick gate runs this suite for every `machining2d` change. The quick gate's 15-minute stall watchdog would mark this silent debug step stalled. Merge this PR after #3595 lands and this suite is green in a normal time. Keep the draft until then.

## Questions / notes

- `Warning::StrategyFallback` prints "Adaptive fell back to Offset rings" (`crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs:550-554`). This new fallback is a 2D Offset or 2D Pocket Outside plan that takes its Auto order. The path note is accurate; the warning line is not. Consider a neutral text, or file a follow-up issue.
- The stand-in note is pinned by its unit test. One assert on the band path that it appears exactly once would pin the wiring too.
- I keep `needs-rework` and the draft. The code is clean; the two items above are the blockers.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
